svg.title: Maple Collective Workshop seasonal cleanup portfolio concept
svg.desc: Fictional landscaping portfolio concept for Maple Collective Workshop, showing a tidy seasonal leaf-cleanup result around a suburban home. Purpose-built demonstration visual for LocalPro Directory; it does not depict a real business, credential, review or completed client project.
